task.description: Perform GIT_MERGE.md's procedure for this WF-03 run on the primary checkout ~/letflow: rebase feature/WF03-ISS0029-20260818 onto current origin/main, resolve any conflicts (this branch is docs/test-only -- test/letflow/definitions/migrations_test.exs, test/specs/REQ-027.md, docs/issues/ISS-0029.yaml, lib/letflow/design/, test/reports/, and handoffs/ -- so conflicts are only plausible on the shared bookkeeping files handoffs/orchestrator.log and handoffs/registry.json if a sibling host merged something in the meantime; resolve those append-both per established convention, never --ours/--theirs from merge habit during a rebase), push, open a PR with title `fix: remove vacuous refute in migrations_test.exs, correct REQ-027 spec [WF03-ISS0029-20260818]`, merge it (gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch), and do the mandatory local cleanup back to a clean main. All upstream gates already passed (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, SECURITY-REVIEWER, REVIEWER, TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, TEST-RUNNER) -- this is pre-authorized per core-directives.md's Humanless Operation, no pause needed.
acceptance_criteria: git rebase origin/main succeeds (conflicts resolved correctly if any, verified by re-reading resolved file content, not by trusting git's auto-resolution claim)
mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test both green after rebase, before opening the PR

Local cleanup returns to a clean main matching the squash-merge commit
